rows: Statutory Regulatory Body (Regulates Telecom & Protects Consumers)

items: TRAI is a Statutory Body (established by TRAI Act, 1997), frequently asked in polity/current affairs questions.
TDSAT was set up in the year 2000 for telecom dispute settlement.
Headquarters location of TRAI is New Delhi.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: TRAI was established under the TRAI Act, 1997 as a statutory body.
The headquarters of TRAI is located in New Delhi.
TDSAT (Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate Tribunal) was formed in the year 2000.
The core mandate of TRAI includes regulating the telecom sector and protecting consumer interests.
